entries.en: Noticing its excited beeping noises, you speak with the curious courier, who informs you that Tataru is on her way with mysterious guests in tow once more. The ecstatic mammet directs you to await her arrival on the islet inlet.
entries.fr: Vous avez parlé avec Mélissagère qui vous a informé<if(gnum4,e,)> de l'arrivée toute prochaine de Tataru sur votre Félicité insulaire. Allez donc l'attendre sur la plage au sud-ouest.
entries.ja: れんらくくんと話した。無人島の南西の浜辺に向かい、「<sheet(EObj,2013296,0)>」でタタルを待とう。

entries.en: You do not have to wait long before Tataru arrives on the beach with Cirina and Sadu at her side. The pair inform you that they have begun a tour of Eorzea at Lyse's suggestion, to behold all it has to offer now that some semblance of peace has settled throughout the realm. As they have come all this way, Tataru suggests that you show the pair around the island, to which you agree with a characteristic nod. After an extensive examination of the local sheep, they seem well satisfied, and offer you a souvenir from the Azim Steppe─traditional garments adjusted for warm climes. With the island once more to yourself, you may focus wholeheartedly on its continued development.
entries.fr: Tataru est venue vous rendre visite en compagnie de Cirina et Sadu. En effet, vos amies se sont déplacées en Éorzéa sur invitation de Lyse, afin de se fa<->mi<->lia<->ri<->ser avec la contrée. Après une promenade dans votre île, elles ont repris la route, non sans vous laisser un petit cadeau. Tataru, heureuse de vous voir prendre vos marques, vous annonce qu'elle repassera à nouveau sous peu.
entries.ja: タタルと共に、シリナとサドゥが冒険者の島にやってきた。いずれ、無人島の浜辺に仲間たちを招き、宴を開いてみるのも良さそうだ。引き続き、島の開拓を続けてみよう。

entries.en: ...But you are doubtless curious as to how we came to know all of this. In truth, it was Lyse who first invited me to tour Eorzea. She told me of the many wonderful things that I have yet to see in this land─sights as beautiful as those found in the Steppe.
